# EMBEPET Pet Supplement Manufacturing

> B2B pet supplement manufacturing by Taizhou Beno Biotech Co., Ltd.
> Wholesale, private label, OEM/ODM for global pet brands and distributors

## Company Overview

**Brand Name:** EMBEPET
**Operating Entity:** Embepet Biotech (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
**Manufacturing Entity:** Taizhou Beno Biotech Co., Ltd. (泰州市贝诺生物科技有限公司)
**Factory Location:** Li Kong Group 3, Donglin Village, Yaowang Street, Taixing City, Jiangsu 225400, China
**Established:** August 2016
**Factory Size:** 3,000 m² total, 2,000 m² production & warehouse

## What We Do

We manufacture pet supplements for brand owners, distributors and global sellers through three service models:

1. **Wholesale** - Ready-to-sell stock formulas in soft chews, tablets, pastes, liquids, powders
2. **Private Label** - Apply your brand to proven formulas with custom packaging
3. **OEM/ODM** - Custom formula development, dosage form selection, packaging design, full production

## Products & Capabilities

**Dosage Forms:**
- Soft chews (main expertise)
- Tablets
- Pastes & gels
- Liquid drops & oils
- Powders
- Granules

**Functional Categories:**
- Joint & mobility (glucosamine, chondroitin, MSM)
- Digestive & probiotics
- Skin & coat (omega-3, biotin)
- Calming & stress relief
- Immune support
- Multivitamins & minerals

**Suitable For:** Dogs and cats

## Key Specifications

**MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity):** 500 bottles for soft chews (lower than 3,000-bottle industry average due to high-speed 1 tonne/hour production line)
**Production Capacity:** 3 production lines, 30 staff, single-shift operation
**Sampling:** Available before bulk orders
**Lead Time:** Confirmed per project based on formula and quantity

## Certifications (Current & Verified)

1. **Eurofins GMP Audit Recognition**
   - Issuer: Eurofins Food Assurance
   - Audit Date: 12–14 Jun 2026
   - Score: 86%
   - Valid Until: 14 Jun 2027
   - Certificate ID: ACCB8AAA422_1

2. **SQF Food Safety Code: Pet Food Manufacturing, Edition 9**
   - Issuer: SQFI / Eurofins Food Assurance Certification US, LLC
   - Audit Date: 12–14 Jun 2026
   - Score: 88 (Good)
   - Valid Until: 28 Aug 2027
   - Certificate / SIN: 105690
   - Food Sector Category: FSC 32 (Pet Premix food)

3. **SQF Quality Code, Edition 9**
   - Same issuer, audit date, validity as SQF Food Safety
   - Covers quality management system beyond food safety

4. **Feed Production License (China)**
   - License No.: 苏饲预（2026）12006
   - Issuing Authority: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
   - Product Scope: Solid, semi-solid and liquid pet additive premixed feed
   - Valid: 26 Apr 2026 – 25 Apr 2031

5. **FDA Food Facility Registration**
   - Registration No.: 10222600768
   - Status: Valid
   - Valid Until: 31 Dec 2026 (renewed biennially)
   - Product Category: Food for Animal Consumption
   - Activity: Animal Food Manufacturer/Processor, Production on behalf of customers

6. **D-U-N-S Number:** 404129816
7. **Unified Social Credit Code (China):** 91321283MA1MR5HB8P

All certificates can be downloaded at: https://embepet.com/en/science

## Quality & Food Safety

- HACCP-based food safety management plan
- Batch traceability (raw materials → finished products)
- In-house inspection + third-party lab testing
- Allergen management & foreign matter controls
- Equipment calibration & sanitation programs
- 24-month shelf life validation for developed products
- Retention samples & quality records for every batch

## OEM/ODM Process

1. **Inquiry & Brief** - Share your product concept, target market, functional direction
2. **Formula & Sampling** - We propose formula (or develop custom), produce samples for approval
3. **Packaging Design** - Choose bottle/pouch/box format, finalize label and artwork
4. **Production & QC** - Batch production with in-process controls and finished product testing
5. **Documentation & Export** - COA, batch records, certificates, customs clearance support

## Who We Work With

- Pet supplement brands launching new SKUs
- E-commerce sellers building private label lines
- Distributors expanding product portfolios
- Retailers sourcing wholesale inventory
